decisions.reason: With a dedicated product page, multiple models, and close fit to the announced digital-health direction, the firm is highly committed and likely to justify its investment by keeping it.
The continuing education institute represents a visible diversification built on existing training resources, so escalation pressures make an early withdrawal unlikely.
As a support tool that extends the established offer, it benefits from sunk-cost and public-commitment pressures, leading management to persist despite uncertain returns.
